scope: Authenticated stale notification injection through the manifest-verified Mix-built OSCORE helper and public native owner

standard.name: IETF Observing Resources in CoAP
standard.summary: A client orders notifications by Observe sequence number and does not treat an older notification as fresh within the 128-second window

source_identity.kind: exact source-file SHA-256; no source commit association asserted

assertions: The relay case subscribes through a UDP relay, delivers 40 and 41 and captures the confirmable authenticated notification carrying 41
Delivering that notification three more times back to back yields no value
After 42 is delivered, delivering the captured 41 three more times yields no value within 500 ms
Against a helper whose freshness admission never returns stale, the relay case delivers 41 again after 42 and fails
The same mutant still passes the back-to-back duplicate step, so that step does not by itself exercise freshness admission
No production source changes accompany this cohort

lanes.command: WOTEX_PATH_DEPS=1 OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR=/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3 mix wotex.software.build --workspace "$ABSOLUTE_EMPTY_WORKSPACE"; then mix wotex.software.run with the same OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR
mix test test/interop/oscore_test.exs:321 --include interop --include software --seed 0 with WOTEX_COAP_NATIVE_WORKER set to the mutant helper
lanes.mutation: native/oscore/observation.c returns no stale admission for an equal or older serial inside 128 seconds
lanes.failure: refute_receive after replaying 41 following 42 received payload 41

unaccepted: The live replay window of 32 for concurrent duplicate ciphertexts
Which layer before freshness admission discards the back-to-back duplicate
